about_the_game:
Explore the darkest depths of the ocean where the only light is bioluminescent coral with the KR Luminous Abyss Tileset! Kokoro Reflections dives back into underwater MV-sized tiles with this pack, offering up a variety of cool blue rocks and dirt to help you build locations that sunlight can’t touch. A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 unique B sheets (with a number of variations that adds up to 18 sheets) can create dark rocky ocean floors, caverns filled with lava and magic-infused walls, whale graveyards, ethereal coral gardens, and more!

Reward your players for finishing a difficult sidequest with an item that lets them breathe underwater, and create incredible locations for them to explore with these tiles. Let them wander around angled cliff faces and behind natural stone arches in search of sunken treasure or cave openings, and break up the monotony of blue and gray stone with pops of color from neon pink, blue, and green veins of crystal. Coral and aquatic plants can add a bit more light to the world, in 3 main color gradients (purple/blue, purple/blue/green, and rainbow) so you can mix and match to fit the area. This pack also includes a character sprite for black smoke so that you can show pools of magma interacting with the ocean’s water. Or skip the water entirely and use these tiles to create caves with pockets of air deep underground! Pick up the KR Luminous Abyss Tileset and give your heroes new cool spaces to visit!


The Luminous Abyss Tileset Includes:

Ground tiles:

Dark water
Neon water
Rainbow grass
Lava
Waterfalls
Many textures and shades of dark rock
Neon rocky ground
and more!


Walls/roofs:

Dark rock walls with several textures, neon walls to match floors.


Also includes:

Stairs to match floors
Neon plants (3 color palettes) with flipped versions
Creature skeletons (several shades for visibility, also includes no-shadow versions).
Rock walls with inward slope
Various shadow tiles to make deep pits
Doorways
Small volcanoes/vents (with smoke animation)
Lots of rocks for variety (with flipped versions and no-shadow versions)
and more!


Events and Animations:
Smoke animations


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
